verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm E2B serves a live llms.txt index at docs.e2b.dev/llms.txt and Markdown versions of docs pages, which point agents back to that index. Many cited docs URLs also resolve as .md pages, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-readable docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the agent-docs offering (e.g. an llms-full.txt or usage guidance), and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.e2b.dev/llms.txt # E2B Docs
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.e2b.dev/llms.txt
